family.shared_definition: a public presentation or staging of entertainment or artistic skill
family.semantic_notes: 'Show' is colloquial and encompasses broad spectacles, while 'performance' emphasizes artistic execution and technical delivery.

source_context_dev: The ticket prices were cheap, but the amateur cast lacked polish and energy throughout the evening.
While the local improv troupe kept the energy light, several skits fell rather flat.
The touring musical featured generic choreography and uninspired pacing across both acts.
The comedy club lineup delivered only a few scattered chuckles with predictable punchlines.
target_context_dev: The lead soprano poured extraordinary emotion into every aria, moving several listeners to tears.
Decades of training culminated in a stunning, emotionally resonant evening at the concert hall.
The seasoned soloist delivered an unforgettable interpretation of the classic concerto.
Every nuance of the dramatic recital resonated deeply with everyone sitting in the auditorium.
source_context_test: The regional company mounted a rather bland production that struggled to hold everyone's attention.
Between missed lighting cues and flat jokes, the evening proved quite unexceptional.
The community hall hosted an ordinary evening of song and dance that left little impression.
The circus routine suffered from sluggish pacing and several routine errors during the first half.
target_context_test: The visiting violinist struck every note with breathtaking emotional power that lingered long afterward.
A profound artistic depth defined the evening, leaving a lasting impression on all who attended.
The stage drama featured brilliant character work that will be discussed for years to come.
The dancer's expressive interpretation created an enchanting, enduring atmosphere in the grand hall.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations (mediocre show, mediocre performance, memorable show, memorable performance) fit naturally after the neutral stem across both casual entertainment and serious concert contexts.

The headlining magician handled complex illusions with effortless dexterity and supreme command.
target_context_dev: The dramatic cast embraced grand gestures, heightened rhetoric, and intense emotional expression onstage.
The tragedy relied on heightened stylistic elements and bold, exaggerated interpretations of the dialogue.
Classical stage conventions and expressive, larger-than-life character acting dominated the entire evening.
The actors delivered their lines with grand dramatic flair, emphasizing bold expressive artistry.
source_context_test: A stunning display of stagecraft and expert timing captivated everyone in the packed arena.
The seasoned troupe executed every intricate trick and complex scene with supreme expertise.
The elaborate Broadway production showcased exquisite technical skill and consummate staging craft.
Every aspect of the grand spectacle reflected the virtuoso touch of an elite creative team.
target_context_test: High drama and stylized movements gave the entire stage interpretation a distinctly operatic feel.
The leading players brought an extravagant, dramatic sensibility to the classical text.
Expressive staging, elaborate costumes, and grand monologues defined the evening's dramatic tone.

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four cross combinations (masterful show, masterful performance, theatrical show, theatrical performance) remain completely coherent and syntactically well-formed following the stem.
